subject: LINE clause
notes: kb/Work PB1001. The NEXT PAGE phrase in a report heading, page heading or page footing is COBOL2199; the group's TYPE is read from the level 1 entry through GroupKindOf, the one TYPE reader BindGroupType also uses. Body groups and report footings take it (2002/pb1001_line_next_page: DE-N, DE-B, DE-P, and RF-G / RF-B).
